title: Router URLs are included twice
reasoning: The DefaultRouter URLs are added once through path("", include(router.urls)) and then appended again with urlpatterns += router.urls. That registers duplicate users/groups/API-root patterns under /api/. Django will route to the first matching pattern, but duplicate route entries can produce repeated schema entries, confusing URL introspection and making future route changes harder to reason about.
recommendation: Keep a single router inclusion style and remove the redundant urlpatterns += router.urls line.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests call concrete API paths and view classes; none inspect the URL resolver, API schema, or route table for duplicate patterns.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a URLConf test that resolves /api/users/ and asserts the users-list route appears only once in the URL pattern set or generated schema.
minimumFixScope: Delete the duplicate router append in hub/urls.py.
